summary: FR-PROXY-006: Proxy.requestTarget forwards basePath + originalUrl() by default and basePath + url() under stripPrefix(true), computed in handle() right after the PathChecker check; a stripped remainder that is not '/' or a raw '/'-suffix of the checked originalUrl() path followed by the same raw query answers 400 before any connection (closes a CRLF injection via the decoded url() of WebSocket upgrades to app.ws routes). 21 focused tests green; full build 4360 tests 0 failures.

already_green_acs: FR-PROXY-006 AC-1 (POST target, JSON body bytes, method token incl. mixed case, encoded path — default path already forwarded originalUrl())
FR-PROXY-006 AC-2 default part and the stripPrefix() accessor false on Proxy.to(url)
declared_limits: Under stripPrefix(true), a WebSocket upgrade to an app.ws route reaches the proxy without a mount view (Dispatcher.handleLegacy, url() = decoded full path, baseUrl ''): a plain path is still forwarded unstripped and an encoded path answers 400. The proxy cannot see its mount prefix there; FR-PROXY-009 AC-4/AC-5 (WebSocket upgrades pass to next() before any check, D-050) removes this path entirely and is out of this lane's scope.
Under stripPrefix(true), a request to exactly the mount path forwards basePath + '/' (+ query), e.g. /api/orders?x=1 -> /base/?x=1, because url() is '/' there (tested).
srs_deltas: FR-PROXY-006: consider stating that under stripPrefix(true) a request to exactly the mount path forwards the base path followed by '/' and the raw query (e.g. Proxy.to("http://h/base").stripPrefix(true) forwards /api/orders?x=1 as /base/?x=1), and that a stripped remainder that is not a raw suffix of the checked originalUrl() answers 400 before any connection — both are implemented and tested but not in the AC text.
